GitHub - Forceflow/ooc_svo_builder: Out-Of-Core Construction of Sparse ...
Out-Of-Core SVO Builder v1.6.4 This is a proof of concept implementation of the algorithm explained in our HPG 2013 paper, Out Of Core Construction of Sparse Voxel Octrees. The project was subsequently updated after the article was also published in Computer Graphics Forum 2014. The paper and additional material can be found on the project page.
